additional_requirements: manic_episode is present for the majority of the total duration of the active and residual portions of the illness
delusions_and_hallucinations occur for 2 or more weeks in the absence of a major mood episode

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.

subtypes.Persecutory Delusions: The false belief that one is being harmed or monitored by other people or organizations.
subtypes.Referential Delusions: The conviction that ordinary events, remarks, or behaviors have specific relevance to oneself.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one possesses special abilities, power, or fame.
subtypes.Erotomanic Delusions: The false belief that another person is in love with or has affection for them.
subtypes.Nihilistic Delusions: A destructive or negative conviction that the world is ending or that a major catastrophe will occur.
subtypes.Somatic Delusions: The baseless conviction that there is a serious abnormality with one's body or organs.
subtypes.Jealous Delusions: The conviction that one's spouse or romantic partner is being unfaithful without sufficient evidence.

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.

subtypes.Auditory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of hearing voices or sounds when there is no actual sound.
subtypes.Visual Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of seeing people or objects that do not exist.
subtypes.Tactile Hallucinations: Experiencing the sensation of being touched or movement on the skin when there is no actual stimulus.
subtypes.Olfactory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of smelling odors that do not exist.
subtypes.Gustatory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of tasting flavors that are not actually present.

S023.name: Negative_Symptoms
S023.description: A state where emotions, motivation, speech, or social interest that should normally be present are diminished or lost.

subtypes.Diminished Emotional Expression: A state of reduced emotional expression in facial expressions, eye contact, intonation of speech, and movements.
subtypes.Avolition: A decrease in motivated self-initiated purposeful activities.
subtypes.Alogia: A state where the quantity of spontaneous speech is significantly reduced.
subtypes.Anhedonia: A decrease in the ability to experience pleasure or interest in enjoyable activities.
subtypes.Asociality: A state where interest in social activities or interpersonal relationships is significantly reduced.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).

subtypes.Inflated Self-Confidence: Feeling capable of anything and believing that failure is impossible, unlike one's usual self.
subtypes.Overestimation of Abilities: Unrealistically assessing one's talents, knowledge, or abilities as superior.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one is a special and important person with a special mission or purpose.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).

subtypes.Reduced Sleep Duration: Sleeping significantly less than usual but feeling refreshed rather than tired.
subtypes.Loss of Sleep Need: Not feeling the urge to sleep or the thought that sleep is necessary.
subtypes.Indifference to Insomnia: Feeling no problem and continuing activities despite staying up for several nights.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.

subtypes.Talkativeness: Speaking far more than usual and continuing to talk without rest.
subtypes.Rapid Speech: Speech speed is so fast that it is difficult for others to understand or interrupt.
subtypes.Pressured Speech: Cannot stop talking or tolerate silence due to an internal pressure to keep speaking.

info.persona: Scott Secrest is a 22‑year‑old art‑obsessed sneaker collector whose fierce competitiveness drives rapid buyer decisions and chronic deadline anxiety, balanced by spontaneous travel, yoga‑infused stress relief, and an unquenchable appetite for trend‑setting culture.
info.professional_persona: Scott Secrest, a 22‑year‑old junior wholesale and retail buyer in Los Angeles, blends natural charisma with razor‑sharp trend spotting to secure exclusive sneaker and streetwear deals, while his spontaneous, competitive streak fuels rapid decision‑making but also leads to occasional deadline scrambling.
info.cultural_background: Scott grew up in a middle‑class white family in Pasadena, California, where the blend of suburban stability and proximity to Los Angeles' creative industries shaped his outlook. His upbringing exposed him to a multicultural environment, fostering an appreciation for diverse artistic expressions and a comfort with eclectic social circles. The Southern Californian emphasis on innovation, health-conscious living, and a fast‑paced lifestyle informs his entrepreneurial spirit and his desire to integrate art and fashion in his professional pursuits.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Scott immerses himself in the vibrant Los Angeles art scene, frequently visiting gallery openings and street art festivals. He enjoys spontaneous weekend trips to nearby coastal towns, where he hikes, snaps photographs, and explores boutique cafés. His sociable nature leads him to host informal networking gatherings for young professionals, often featuring live music or improv performances. He collects limited‑edition sneakers and stays updated on streetwear trends, which feeds his buyer instincts. To manage stress, he practices yoga and mindfulness meditation, and he occasionally journals his thoughts to channel his critical and competitive mindset into personal growth.
info.sports_persona: Scott Secrest fuels his fitness habit by joining a local beach‑volleyball club that practices every Saturday, cheering on the Los Angeles Lakers and LA Galaxy for a sporty vibe, and hitting the gym for occasional weight training, though his spontaneous schedule sometimes leaves him skipping sessions.
info.arts_persona: Scott Secrest is a fixture at LA gallery openings and street‑art festivals, often citing Shepard Fairey's graphic activism, vibing to live sets by Tame Impala, and balancing his sneaker collection with limited‑edition prints from emerging muralists like JR, all of which feed his visual merchandising instincts.
info.travel_persona: Scott Secrest prefers spontaneous weekend escapes, hopping from Malibu’s surf‑capped cliffs to Santa Barbara’s boutique cafés on a whim, while day‑dreaming about a future fashion‑focused trip to Tokyo’s Harajuku district and a culturally immersive stay in Berlin’s Kreuzberg scene, all funded by a modest travel stipend.
info.culinary_persona: Scott Secrest, an eager yet novice home‑cook, gravitates toward avocado‑toast brunches, craft coffee brewed with Ethiopian beans, and indulgent ahi‑tuna poke bowls spiced with yuzu, while routinely scouting Los Angeles pop‑up eateries for the latest ramen innovations.

info.persona: Alice Baddour is a mechanically curious, socially vibrant 32‑year‑old who can rebuild a V8 engine while line‑dancing to Chris Stapleton, and they never miss a chance to host a potluck after a weekend road trip.
info.professional_persona: Alice Baddour is a seasoned automotive technician who blends deep mechanical expertise with emerging EV technology, excelling at OBD‑II diagnostics, engine rebuilds, and high‑voltage safety while leading a workshop team through organized yet adaptable workflow, mentoring junior staff, and consistently meeting service targets; they balance curiosity with practicality and maintain emotional stability under shop pressures.
info.cultural_background: Alice grew up in Auburn, a close‑knit community in Simpson County, Kentucky. Her white, Southern Appalachian roots are reflected in a blend of practical work ethic, family‑centered values, and a warm hospitality that characterizes the region. Raised in a household that valued hands‑on trades, she inherited a respect for hard work and self‑reliance while also embracing the community’s traditions—county fairs, church picnics, and a love for the Kentucky Derby. Though she works in a traditionally male‑dominated field, the local culture’s growing acceptance of women in skilled trades has encouraged her to pursue leadership roles and mentor other women. Her cultural identity balances modesty with a forward‑looking curiosity about new technology.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside the shop, Alice is a social spark who thrives on group activities. She’s an active member of the local car club, attends monthly meet‑ups, and enjoys weekend road trips through the Kentucky countryside. She loves line dancing at country music festivals, volunteers at church and community food‑bank events, and spends evenings woodworking custom garage storage solutions. Gardening, hiking, and occasional kayaking keep her fit, while she relaxes by reading automotive magazines and listening to podcasts on emerging EV tech. Cooking traditional Appalachian dishes and hosting potluck gatherings round out her vibrant social life.
info.sports_persona: Alice Baddour is a weekend enthusiast of line dancing at country music festivals, hikes with the Kentucky Trail Hikers, paddles the Ohio River with the Bluegrass Kayak Crew, and loyally follows the Louisville Cardinals football, Cincinnati Bengals, and Louisville Bats, while occasionally joining the local car‑club’s track‑day simulations as a form of cross‑training, reflecting their sociable, cooperative spirit and assertive drive to stay fit.
info.arts_persona: Alice Baddour fuels their creative side by devouring Motor Trend and Automobile magazines, listening to the Fully Charged podcast for EV insights, dancing to Chris Stapleton and Dolly Parton at regional country‑music festivals, and attending community‑theater productions of classic Appalachian plays whenever time permits, a blend of curiosity and social enthusiasm that shapes their leisure.
info.travel_persona: Alice Baddour prefers meticulously planned road‑trip itineraries that combine scenic drives through the Kentucky Bluegrass region with pit stops at the Henry Ford Museum in Detroit, spontaneous weekend hikes in the Great Smoky Mountains, and music‑filled evenings in Nashville, all while budgeting for fuel and keeping a flexible schedule to accommodate church volunteer commitments, a testament to their organized yet adaptable approach to adventure.
info.culinary_persona: Alice Baddour enjoys crafting hearty Appalachian meals like smoked pork shoulder with collard greens, skillet cornbread, and pinto beans, showcases solid intermediate cooking skills by organizing weekly potluck gatherings, and loves experimenting with local ingredients such as heirloom tomatoes and sweet potatoes to infuse traditional dishes with a fresh twist, a habit that mirrors their balance of tradition and curiosity.

info.persona: Thomas Oki is a curious, art‑infused administrative veteran who balances meticulous organization with creative spontaneity, mentors community youth, and channels disciplined mindfulness into health, finances, and flavorful culinary adventures.
info.professional_persona: Thomas Oki, a 46‑year‑old executive administrative professional, leverages their two‑decade mastery of Office 365, Google Workspace, and project‑management tools like Asana to coordinate multi‑departmental initiatives, while injecting artistic flair into corporate culture through employee art showcases that reflect their curiosity and openness to unconventional thinking.
info.cultural_background: Thomas identifies as African American and grew up in the Atlanta metropolitan area, where his family’s roots trace back to the South’s post‑civil‑rights generation. His cultural upbringing blends traditional Southern customs—such as family gatherings, church fellowship, and soulful music—with a strong emphasis on education and community service. Growing up in a predominantly Black neighborhood, he was immersed in the rich storytelling, food, and artistic expressions of African American culture, which continue to shape his values of harmony, respect, and collective uplift. Living in Woodstock, he engages with both the local Black community and the broader multicultural fabric of Cobb County, participating in Juneteenth festivities, supporting neighborhood art initiatives, and mentoring youth through community programs.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Thomas spends his weekends exploring Woodstock’s art scene, attending gallery openings and community theater productions. He is an avid photographer, capturing the rolling hills and historic architecture around Cobb County. He enjoys reading a mix of contemporary fiction, leadership biographies, and emerging‑technology articles, often joining local book‑club discussions. Cooking new recipes—especially combining Southern flavors with global influences—offers a creative outlet. He hikes the nearby Kennesaw Mountain trails and practices mindfulness meditation to balance his social and solitary time. Volunteering at the local community center, he mentors high school students in basic computer skills and organizes occasional art workshops.
info.sports_persona: Thomas Oki hikes the Kennesaw Mountain trails with the local 'Peach Ridge Hikers' club, follows the Atlanta Braves, Atlanta Falcons, and Atlanta United with avid enthusiasm, and squeezes in a weekly Tuesday night tennis match at the community center, balancing their love for solitary exercise with occasional team spirit.
info.arts_persona: Thomas Oki immerses themselves in Woodstock’s vibrant art scene, attending gallery openings that showcase artists like Kerry James Marshall and Theaster Gates, volunteering as a facilitator for community theatre workshops, and capturing historic Cobb County architecture through photography—activities that satisfy their curiosity and reinforce their commitment to fostering local creativity.
info.travel_persona: Thomas Oki plans weekend getaways with a blend of precision and spontaneity, driving the scenic routes to Asheville’s Blue Ridge Mountains and the jazz‑filled streets of New Orleans while scouting local farmers’ markets, all while mindfully budgeting to keep their 401(k) contributions on track.
info.culinary_persona: Thomas Oki delights in merging Southern staples—fried green tomatoes, collard greens, and shrimp and grits—with global flavors like Korean gochujang, Moroccan preserved lemons, and Mexican mole, crafting dishes such as gochujang‑glazed shrimp and grits or collard‑green tacos, though they often over‑salt the sauces when juggling recipe experiments with work emails.
